passages.text: In the twelfth year of the reign of Ahaz over Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria nine years.
passages.sermon:
Ahaz was king of Judah.
He reigned for twelve years.
In the twelfth year of Ahaz’s reign, Hoshea became king of Israel.
Hoshea was the son of Elah.
Hoshea ruled in Samaria.
He reigned over Israel for nine years.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לְאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ הוֹשֵׁ֨עַ בֶּן־ אֵלָ֧ה בְשֹׁמְר֛וֹן עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תֵּ֥שַׁע שָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, but not like the kings of Israel who preceded him.
passages.sermon:
Hoshea was king of Israel.
Hoshea did evil.
The LORD saw Hoshea’s evil.
Hoshea’s evil was not like the kings of Israel before him.
The kings before Hoshea did greater evil.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה רַ֗ק לֹ֚א כְּמַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Shalmaneser king of Assyria attacked him, and Hoshea became his vassal and paid him tribute.
passages.sermon:
Shalmaneser was the king of Assyria.
Shalmaneser attacked Hoshea.
Hoshea was the king of Israel.
Hoshea became a servant to Shalmaneser.
Hoshea paid tribute to Shalmaneser.
passages.original: עָלָ֣יו עָלָ֔ה שַׁלְמַנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַֽיְהִי־ ל֤וֹ הוֹשֵׁ֙עַ֙ עֶ֔בֶד וַיָּ֥שֶׁב ל֖וֹ מִנְחָֽה׃

passages.text: But the king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea had conspired to send envoys to King So of Egypt, and that he had not paid tribute to the king of Assyria as in previous years. Therefore the king of Assyria arrested Hoshea and put him in prison.
passages.sermon:
Hoshea was king of Israel.
The king of Assyria ruled a powerful empire.
The king of Assyria found out that Hoshea had made a conspiracy.
Hoshea sent messengers to So, king of Egypt.
Hoshea did not pay tribute to the king of Assyria as he had done in previous years.
The king of Assyria arrested Hoshea.
The king of Assyria put Hoshea in prison.
passages.original: וַיִּמְצָא֩ מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֨וּר בְּהוֹשֵׁ֜עַ קֶ֗שֶׁר אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ אֶל־ ס֣וֹא מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְלֹא־ הֶעֱלָ֥ה מִנְחָ֛ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר כְּשָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֑ה וַֽיַּעַצְרֵ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיַּאַסְרֵ֖הוּ בֵּ֥ית כֶּֽלֶא׃

passages.text: Then the king of Assyria invaded the whole land, marched up to Samaria, and besieged it for three years.
passages.sermon:
The king of Assyria was a powerful foreign ruler.
He invaded the entire land of Israel.
He marched up to the city of Samaria.
He surrounded Samaria and laid siege to it.
He kept the city under siege for three years.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֖וּר בְּכָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיַּ֙עַל֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַיָּ֥צַר עָלֶ֖יהָ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and carried away the Israelites to Assyria, where he settled them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.
passages.sermon:
Hoshea was king of Israel.
In the ninth year of Hoshea’s reign, the king of Assyria attacked Samaria.
The king of Assyria captured Samaria.
He took the Israelites away from their land.
He carried the Israelites to Assyria.
He settled the Israelites in Halah.
He settled them in Gozan, by the Habor River.
He settled them in the cities of the Medes.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת הַתְּשִׁיעִ֜ית לְהוֹשֵׁ֗עַ לָכַ֤ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ אֶת־ שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַיֶּ֥גֶל אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַשּׁ֑וּרָה וַיֹּ֨שֶׁב אֹתָ֜ם בַּחְלַ֧ח וּבְחָב֛וֹר נְהַ֥ר גּוֹזָ֖ן וְעָרֵ֥י מָדָֽי׃פ

passages.text: All this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They had worshiped other gods and walked in the customs of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites, as well as in the practices introduced by the kings of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel sinned against the LORD their God.
The LORD had brought them out of the land of Egypt.
He rescued them from the power of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.
The Israelites worshiped other gods.
They followed the customs of the nations that the LORD had driven out before them.
They also followed the practices that the kings of Israel had introduced.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּֽי־ חָטְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם הַמַּעֲלֶ֤ה אֹתָם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִתַּ֕חַת יַ֖ד פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיִּֽירְא֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃ וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּחֻקּ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: The Israelites secretly did things against the LORD their God that were not right. From watchtower to fortified city, they built high places in all their cities.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites acted in secret.
They did things that were wrong.
They sinned against the LORD their God.
They built high places for themselves.
They did this in every city.
They built these places from the smallest watchtower to the largest fortified city.
passages.original: וַיְחַפְּא֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ כֵ֔ן עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּבְנ֨וּ לָהֶ֤ם בָּמוֹת֙ בְּכָל־ עָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם מִמִּגְדַּ֥ל נוֹצְרִ֖ים עַד־ עִ֥יר מִבְצָֽר׃

passages.text: They set up for themselves sacred pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites set up sacred pillars for themselves.
They set up Asherah poles for themselves.
They placed these on every high hill.
They placed these under every green tree.
passages.original: וַיַּצִּ֧בוּ לָהֶ֛ם מַצֵּב֖וֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִ֑ים עַ֚ל כָּל־ גִּבְעָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־ עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן׃

passages.text: They burned incense on all the high places like the nations that the LORD had driven out before them. They did wicked things, provoking the LORD to anger.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites burned incense on all the high places.
They acted like the nations that the LORD had driven out before them.
They did wicked things.
They provoked the LORD to anger.
passages.original: וַיְקַטְּרוּ־ שָׁם֙ בְּכָל־ בָּמ֔וֹת כַּגּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֶגְלָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ דְּבָרִ֣ים רָעִ֔ים לְהַכְעִ֖יס אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: They served idols, although the LORD had told them, “You shall not do this thing.”
passages.sermon: The people of Israel and Judah served idols.\r\nThe LORD had told them not to do this thing.\r\nThe LORD had clearly commanded them not to serve idols.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעַבְד֖וּ הַגִּלֻּלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Yet through all His prophets and seers, the LORD warned Israel and Judah, saying, “Turn from your wicked ways and keep My commandments and statutes, according to the entire Law that I commanded your fathers and delivered to you through My servants the prophets.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel and Judah.
The LORD sent messages to Israel and Judah.
He used all His prophets and seers.
The LORD warned the people through them.
He said, “Turn from your wicked ways.
Keep My commandments.
Keep My statutes.
Obey the entire Law.
I commanded this Law to your fathers.
I delivered this Law to you through My servants the prophets.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֣עַד יְהוָ֡ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּבִיהוּדָ֡ה בְּיַד֩ כָּל־ נְבִיאוֹ כָל־ חֹזֶ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר שֻׁ֝֠בוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֤ם הָֽרָעִים֙ וְשִׁמְרוּ֙ מִצְוֺתַ֣י חֻקּוֹתַ֔י כְּכָ֨ל־ הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶת־ אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁלַ֣חְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדַ֥י הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

passages.text: But they would not listen, and they stiffened their necks like their fathers, who did not believe the LORD their God.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel and Judah did not listen to the LORD.
They refused to obey Him.
They became stubborn.
They acted just like their fathers.
Their fathers did not believe in the LORD their God.
passages.original: וְלֹ֖א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַיַּקְשׁ֤וּ אֶת־ עָרְפָּם֙ כְּעֹ֣רֶף אֲבוֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א הֶאֱמִ֔ינוּ בַּֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They rejected His statutes and the covenant He had made with their fathers, as well as the decrees He had given them. They pursued worthless idols and themselves became worthless, going after the surrounding nations that the LORD had commanded them not to imitate.
passages.sermon:
Israel and Judah rejected the statutes of the LORD.
They rejected the covenant that the LORD made with their fathers.
They rejected the decrees that the LORD had given them.
They followed worthless idols.
They became worthless themselves.
They followed the nations around them.
The LORD had commanded them not to do as those nations did.
passages.original: וַיִּמְאֲס֣וּ אֶת־ חֻקָּ֗יו וְאֶת־ בְּרִיתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֣ת אֶת־ אֲבוֹתָ֔ם וְאֵת֙ עֵֽדְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵעִ֖יד בָּ֑ם וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ אַחֲרֵ֤י הַהֶ֙בֶל֙ וַיֶּהְבָּ֔לוּ וְאַחֲרֵ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִֽיבֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֖י עֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God and made for themselves two cast idols of calves and an Asherah pole. They bowed down to all the host of heaven and served Baal.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel turned away from the LORD their God.
They left all His commandments.
They made two idols shaped like calves.
They made an Asherah pole.
They bowed down to the stars and all the host of heaven.
They served Baal.
passages.original: וַיַּעַזְב֗וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם מַסֵּכָ֖ה שְׁנֵים עֲגָלִ֑ים וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֲשֵׁירָ֗ה וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ֙ לְכָל־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־ הַבָּֽעַל׃

passages.text: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire and practiced divination and soothsaying. They devoted themselves to doing evil in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD.
They sacrificed their sons in the fire.
They sacrificed their daughters in the fire.
They practiced divination.
They practiced soothsaying.
They devoted themselves to doing evil.
They provoked the LORD to anger.
passages.original: וַֽ֠יַּעֲבִירוּ אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֤ם וְאֶת־ בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וַיִּקְסְמ֥וּ קְסָמִ֖ים וַיְנַחֵ֑שׁוּ וַיִּֽתְמַכְּר֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So the LORD was very angry with Israel, and He removed them from His presence. Only the tribe of Judah remained, and even Judah did not keep the commandments of the LORD their God, but lived according to the customs Israel had introduced.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD became very angry with Israel.
The LORD removed Israel from His presence.
Only the tribe of Judah remained.
Judah did not keep the commandments of the LORD their God.
Judah followed the customs that Israel had introduced.
passages.original: וַיִּתְאַנַּ֨ף יְהוָ֤ה מְאֹד֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְסִרֵ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו לֹ֣א נִשְׁאַ֔ר רַ֛ק שֵׁ֥בֶט יְהוּדָ֖ה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃ גַּם־ יְהוּדָ֕ה לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔ר אֶת־ מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ בְּחֻקּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: So the LORD rejected all the descendants of Israel. He afflicted them and delivered them into the hands of plunderers, until He had banished them from His presence.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD rejected all the descendants of Israel.
The LORD caused them to suffer.
The LORD gave them into the hands of plunderers.
The LORD did this until He banished them from His presence.
passages.original: וַיִּמְאַ֨ס יְהוָ֜ה בְּכָל־ זֶ֤רַע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיְעַנֵּ֔ם וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיַד־ שֹׁסִ֑ים עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁלִיכָ֖ם מִפָּנָֽיו׃

passages.text: When the LORD had torn Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat king, and Jeroboam led Israel away from following the LORD and caused them to commit a great sin.
passages.sermon:
The LORD separated Israel from the house of David.
Israel no longer belonged to David’s family line.
The people of Israel chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king.
Jeroboam became the ruler of Israel.
Jeroboam led Israel away from following the LORD.
Jeroboam caused Israel to sin greatly.
Israel committed a great sin because of Jeroboam.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ קָרַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵעַל֙ בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֔ד וַיַּמְלִ֖יכוּ אֶת־ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֑ט וַיַּדֵּא יָרָבְעָ֤ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְהֶחֱטֵיאָ֖ם חֲטָאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: The Israelites persisted in all the sins that Jeroboam had committed and did not turn away from them.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were the people God chose.
Jeroboam was their king.
Jeroboam committed many sins.
The Israelites followed Jeroboam’s sins.
They did everything Jeroboam did wrong.
They did not stop doing these sins.
They did not turn away from Jeroboam’s sins.
passages.original: וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּכָל־ חַטֹּ֥אות יָרָבְעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה לֹא־ סָ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

passages.text: Finally, the LORD removed Israel from His presence, as He had declared through all His servants the prophets. So Israel was exiled from their homeland into Assyria, where they are to this day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD spoke through His prophets.
The LORD warned Israel through His servants.
The LORD removed Israel from His presence.
The LORD did what He said through His prophets.
The LORD sent Israel away from their land.
The LORD sent Israel into Assyria.
Israel remains in Assyria to this day.
passages.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר־ הֵסִ֨יר יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֔יו כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד כָּל־ עֲבָדָ֣יו הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים וַיִּ֨גֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל מֵעַ֤ל אַדְמָתוֹ֙ אַשּׁ֔וּרָה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

passages.text: Then the king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites. They took possession of Samaria and lived in its towns.
passages.sermon:
The king of Assyria acted with authority.
He brought people from Babylon.
He brought people from Cuthah.
He brought people from Avva.
He brought people from Hamath.
He brought people from Sepharvaim.
He settled these people in the towns of Samaria.
He put them there instead of the Israelites.
These new people took possession of Samaria.
They lived in the towns of Samaria.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֡וּר מִבָּבֶ֡ל וּ֠מִכּוּ֠תָה וּמֵעַוָּ֤א וּמֵֽחֲמָת֙ וּסְפַרְוַ֔יִם וַיֹּ֙שֶׁב֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן תַּ֖חַת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽרְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַיֵּֽשְׁב֖וּ בְּעָרֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Now when the settlers first lived there, they did not worship the LORD, so He sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
passages.sermon:
The new settlers came to live in the land of Samaria.
These people did not worship the LORD.
The LORD saw that they did not honor Him.
The LORD sent lions among the people.
The lions attacked them.
The lions killed some of the settlers.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּתְחִלַּת֙ שִׁבְתָּ֣ם שָׁ֔ם לֹ֥א יָרְא֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיְשַׁלַּ֨ח יְהוָ֤ה בָּהֶם֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֲרָי֔וֹת וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ הֹרְגִ֖ים בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: So they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The peoples that you have removed and placed in the cities of Samaria do not know the requirements of the God of the land. Because of this, He has sent lions among them, which are indeed killing them off.”
passages.sermon:
The people spoke to the king of Assyria.
They said, “You removed nations from their lands.
You settled these nations in the cities of Samaria.
These people do not know the laws of the God of this land.
The God of this land has sent lions among them.
The lions are killing them.
This happens because they do not know the laws of the God of this land.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִגְלִ֙יתָ֙ וַתּ֙וֹשֶׁב֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י שֹׁמְר֔וֹן לֹ֣א יָֽדְע֔וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיְשַׁלַּח־ בָּ֣ם אֶת־ הָאֲרָי֗וֹת וְהִנָּם֙ מְמִיתִ֣ים אוֹתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ אֵינָ֣ם יֹדְעִ֔ים אֶת־ מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then the king of Assyria commanded: “Send back one of the priests you carried off from Samaria, and have him go back to live there and teach the requirements of the God of the land.”
passages.sermon:
The king of Assyria gave an order.
He spoke to his officials.
He said, “Send one of the priests back to Samaria.
This priest was taken from there before.
Let him return and live in Samaria.
Let him teach the people there.
He must teach them the requirements of the God of the land.”
passages.original: וַיְצַ֨ו מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֜וּר לֵאמֹ֗ר הֹלִ֤יכוּ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ אֶחָ֤ד מֵהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִגְלִיתֶ֣ם מִשָּׁ֔ם וְיֵלְכ֖וּ וְיֵ֣שְׁבוּ שָׁ֑ם וְיֹרֵ֕ם אֶת־ מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Thus one of the priests they had carried away came and lived in Bethel, and he began to teach them how they should worship the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The king of Assyria had taken people from Samaria and sent them away.
He had also taken priests from Samaria.
One of these priests returned from exile.
This priest came to the city of Bethel.
He lived in Bethel.
He began to teach the new people in the land.
He taught them how to worship the LORD.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֞א אֶחָ֣ד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִגְלוּ֙ מִשֹּׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֑ל וַֽיְהִי֙ מוֹרֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם אֵ֖יךְ יִֽירְא֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, the people of each nation continued to make their own gods in the cities where they had settled, and they set them up in the shrines that the people of Samaria had made on the high places.
passages.sermon:
Each nation made its own gods.
Each nation lived in its own city.
Each nation set up its gods in that city.
The people placed their gods in shrines on the high places.
The people of Samaria had built these shrines before.
Each nation used these shrines for its own gods.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ עֹשִׂ֔ים גּ֥וֹי גּ֖וֹי אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיַּנִּ֣יחוּ׀ בְּבֵ֣ית הַבָּמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ הַשֹּׁ֣מְרֹנִ֔ים גּ֥וֹי גּוֹי֙ בְּעָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם יֹשְׁבִ֖ים שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: The men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, the men of Cuth made Nergal, the men of Hamath made Ashima, the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech the gods of the Sepharvaim.
passages.sermon:
The men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth.
The men of Cuth made Nergal.
The men of Hamath made Ashima.
The Avvites made Nibhaz.
The Avvites also made Tartak.
The Sepharvites burned their children in the fire.
They did this for Adrammelech and Anammelech.
Adrammelech and Anammelech were the gods of the Sepharvaim.
passages.original: וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י בָבֶ֗ל עָשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ סֻכּ֣וֹת בְּנ֔וֹת וְאַנְשֵׁי־ כ֔וּת עָשׂ֖וּ אֶת־ נֵֽרְגַ֑ל וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י חֲמָ֖ת עָשׂ֥וּ אֶת־ אֲשִׁימָֽא׃ וְהָעַוִּ֛ים עָשׂ֥וּ נִבְחַ֖ז וְאֶת־ תַּרְתָּ֑ק וְהַסְפַרְוִ֗ים שֹׂרְפִ֤ים אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶם֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ לְאַדְרַמֶּ֥לֶךְ וַֽעֲנַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֱלֹהַּ סְפָרִים׃

passages.text: So the new residents worshiped the LORD, but they also appointed for themselves priests of all sorts to serve in the shrines of the high places.
passages.sermon:
The new residents lived in the land of Samaria.
They worshiped the LORD.
They also chose priests for themselves from among their own people.
These priests served at the shrines on the high places.
The people made these shrines in Samaria.
The priests led worship in these shrines.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ יְרֵאִ֖ים אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֤ם מִקְצוֹתָם֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י בָמ֔וֹת וַיִּהְי֛וּ עֹשִׂ֥ים לָהֶ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית הַבָּמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: They worshiped the LORD, but they also served their own gods according to the customs of the nations from which they had been carried away.
passages.sermon: The new residents feared the LORD.\r\nThey also served their own gods.\r\nThey followed the customs of the nations from which they had been taken.
passages.original: אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה הָי֣וּ יְרֵאִ֑ים וְאֶת־ אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶם֙ הָי֣וּ עֹֽבְדִ֔ים כְּמִשְׁפַּט֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הִגְל֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם מִשָּֽׁם׃

passages.text: To this day they are still practicing their former customs. None of them worship the LORD or observe the statutes, ordinances, laws, and commandments that the LORD gave the descendants of Jacob, whom He named Israel.
passages.sermon:
The people who live there still follow their old customs.
They do not worship the LORD.
They do not keep the statutes that God gave.
They do not follow the ordinances that God commanded.
They do not obey the laws and commandments that the LORD gave.
The LORD gave these commands to the descendants of Jacob.
God named Jacob “Israel.”
passages.original: עַ֣ד הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ הֵ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים כַּמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֑ים אֵינָ֤ם יְרֵאִים֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וְאֵינָ֣ם עֹשִׂ֗ים כְּחֻקֹּתָם֙ וּכְמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם וְכַתּוֹרָ֣ה וְכַמִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֥ם שְׁמ֖וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: For the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites and commanded them, “Do not worship other gods or bow down to them; do not serve them or sacrifice to them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD made a covenant with the Israelites.
The LORD gave them commands.
He said, “Do not worship other gods.
Do not bow down to other gods.
Do not serve other gods.
Do not sacrifice to other gods.”
passages.original: וַיִּכְרֹ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה אִתָּם֙ בְּרִ֔ית וַיְצַוֵּ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תִֽירְא֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְלֹא־ תִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א תַעַבְד֔וּם וְלֹ֥א תִזְבְּח֖וּ לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Instead, worship the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt with great power and an outstretched arm. You are to bow down to Him and offer sacrifices to Him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD brought you out of the land of Egypt.
He used great power.
He used an outstretched arm.
You must fear the LORD.
You must bow down to the LORD.
You must offer sacrifices to the LORD.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אִֽם־ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ הֶעֱלָ֨ה אֶתְכֶ֜ם מֵאֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם בְּכֹ֧חַ גָּד֛וֹל וּבִזְר֥וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֖ה אֹת֣וֹ תִירָ֑אוּ וְל֥וֹ תִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ וְל֥וֹ תִזְבָּֽחוּ׃

passages.text: And you must always be careful to observe the statutes, ordinances, laws, and commandments He wrote for you. Do not worship other gods.
passages.sermon:
God gave you statutes, ordinances, laws, and commandments.
He wrote these for you.
You must keep them.
You must do them every day.
Do not worship other gods.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַחֻקִּ֨ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֜ים וְהַתּוֹרָ֤ה וְהַמִּצְוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּתַ֣ב לָכֶ֔ם תִּשְׁמְר֥וּן לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א תִֽירְא֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃

passages.text: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you. Do not worship other gods, but worship the LORD your God, and He will deliver you from the hands of all your enemies.”
passages.sermon:
God made a covenant with you.
Do not forget this covenant.
Do not worship other gods.
Worship only the LORD your God.
The LORD will save you from all your enemies.
passages.original: וְהַבְּרִ֛ית אֲשֶׁר־ כָּרַ֥תִּי אִתְּכֶ֖ם לֹ֣א תִשְׁכָּ֑חוּ וְלֹ֥א תִֽירְא֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃ כִּ֛י אִֽם־ אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם תִּירָ֑אוּ וְהוּא֙ יַצִּ֣יל אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִיַּ֖ד כָּל־ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But they would not listen, and they persisted in their former customs.
passages.sermon:
The people did not listen.
They refused to obey.
They continued to follow their old customs.
They acted as they had before.
passages.original: וְלֹ֖א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ כִּ֛י אִֽם־ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֥ם הָֽרִאשׁ֖וֹן הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: So these nations worshiped the LORD but also served their idols, and to this day their children and grandchildren continue to do as their fathers did.
passages.sermon:
These nations worshiped the LORD.
They also served their idols.
Their children did the same things.
Their grandchildren also followed these ways.
They acted just as their fathers had done.
They continue these practices to this day.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ׀ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה יְרֵאִים֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶת־ פְּסִֽילֵיהֶ֖ם הָי֣וּ עֹֽבְדִ֑ים גַּם־ בְּנֵיהֶ֣ם׀ וּבְנֵ֣י בְנֵיהֶ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֤וּ אֲבֹתָם֙ הֵ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ
